HIGH.description: Three artifacts can drive execution intent: signal_lifecycle_effective.csv, signal_lifecycle.csv, and trade_opportunities.csv.
HIGH.impact: Capital deployment may use a different lifecycle view than dashboards or lifecycle gate.
HIGH.recommended_remediation: H006: Enforce single read path — effective lifecycle only; trade_opportunities as derived view labeled non-authoritative.

HIGH.description: master_execution_gate.json (batch snapshot) and adaptive_risk_state.json (continuous intelligence) both inform execution restrictions.
HIGH.impact: execute_trades reads adaptive_risk_state directly while batch gate uses master snapshot.
HIGH.recommended_remediation: H006: Execution batch decisions must consume master_execution_gate.json only; adaptive_risk_state reserved for intelligence/producer input.

MEDIUM.description: portfolio_allocation_recommendations.csv and portfolio_allocation_summary.json both represent allocation state.
MEDIUM.impact: Dashboard or manage_positions may display summary while sizing uses CSV.
MEDIUM.recommended_remediation: H006: Mark summary JSON as derived read-only; dashboards must read recommendations CSV.

MEDIUM.description: governance_execution_readiness.py validates signal_lifecycle.csv staleness, not signal_lifecycle_effective.csv.
MEDIUM.impact: Operational readiness may pass while effective lifecycle is stale.
MEDIUM.recommended_remediation: H006: Align readiness checks to authoritative effective lifecycle artifact.

MEDIUM.description: view_results.py displays positions_snapshot.csv which may lag live broker state.
MEDIUM.impact: Operator may see stale positions while execution uses live broker API.
MEDIUM.recommended_remediation: H006: Label snapshot as derived; show as-of timestamp; optional live broker refresh panel.

MEDIUM.description: place_live_orders.apply_effective_lifecycle_columns() re-merges effective columns at read time instead of consuming pre-built effective artifact only.
MEDIUM.impact: In-memory transformation may diverge from build_effective_lifecycle output.
MEDIUM.recommended_remediation: H006: Require pre-built signal_lifecycle_effective.csv; remove runtime column merge.

LOW.description: ticker_timeline_builder.py falls back from effective to raw signal_lifecycle.csv.
LOW.impact: Historical timeline may mix authoritative and pre-effective states.
LOW.recommended_remediation: H006: Use effective only; treat raw lifecycle as historical archive.

LOW.description: master_execution_gate (Python batch) and triton_execution_gate (Node runtime) operate at different layers.
LOW.impact: Intentional layering — not a bypass — but operators must understand both layers.
LOW.recommended_remediation: Document layered authority in operator runbook; no merge required.
